messages:
anna: Heads-up: we flipped on the KV-prefetch + tighter micro-batching scheduler in canary (rw-v2-medium) on cap-2 in us-east-1. Initial telemetry: p50 gen 95ms -> 70ms (~26% improvement), p95 420ms -> 325ms (~22.6%), estimated token spend down ~16% for steady-state chat workloads. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/runtime/kv-prefetch-canary :tada:

deploy-bot: Started canary rollout service=runtime-worker group=cap-2 region=us-east-1 build=sha256:ff9d21a

liam: Nice! Can you drop the runtime config we changed so infra can scan?

anna: Sure, config diff (runtime flags we enabled):

```yaml
runtime_flags:
  kv_prefetch_enabled: true
  kv_prefetch_max_per_gpu: 256
  kv_prefetch_trigger_tokens: 48
  batching:
    micro_batch_window_ms: 5  # was 12
    max_batch_size: 56
  kv_eviction_policy: "lru-ttl"
```

anna: Notes: trigger at 48 tokens to prefete only when sessions show meaningful prefixes; capped items per GPU to avoid memory pressure; eviction uses LRU with TTL aging to prevent long-tail churn.

eva: Saw a small blip in p99 for >8k contexts in the first 20m on one host. Any automated rollback?

anna: We added a safety rule: if p99 for sequences >4k goes up >10% vs baseline for a 10-minute window, canary aborts and rollbacks. Also if OOMs >1 on any GPU in pool, immediate rollback.

maria: Good. Does this change require SDK updates for customers?

anna: No SDK changes. All runtime-side. Customer API unchanged. We'll publish a short note describing the improvement and rollout plan.

product-bot: @product team asked for a 1-line customer-facing blurb and a 2-sentence internal summary. Can someone provide?

liam: Customer blurb suggestion: "Improved response latency and cost on multi-turn requests through smarter KV prefetching and micro-batchingno action required." Internal: "Canary live in us-east-1 cap-2; p50 down ~26%, p95 down ~23%; auto-rollback rules in place. Staged rollout to other US regions in ~90m if stable."

anna: Perf breakdown (preliminary): rw-v2-small ~5% p50, rw-v2-medium ~26% p50, rw-v2-large ~12% p50. We'll bake full per-model numbers into the release note.

eva: Please tag #release-war-room if the auto-rollback triggers. I'll monitor SLOs.

anna: Plan: monitor for 90 minutes; if healthy, push to remaining US regions in waves, then EU. Runbook + metrics link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/kv-prefetch-rollout. Will post an update at +90m. :rocket:
